evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 长春仙馆
evidence.excerpt_zh: 茹古涵今之南為長春仙館門三楹正殿五楹後殿為緑䕃軒正殿西廊後為麗景軒（圓明園冊）臣等謹按長春仙館為皇上舊時賜居四十景之一也其後恭值佳辰令節迎奉安輿駐居斯館殿額與緑䕃軒麗景軒諸額皆御書殿内聨曰安輿歡洽宜春永慶節誠依愛日長亦御書
evidence.summary: South of 茹古涵今: 長春仙館, a three-bay gate and five-bay main hall, 緑䕃軒 behind and 麗景軒 to the west. The note says this was Qianlong's own residence as a prince, later used to receive his mother on festival days.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label: a building stood here, its name unknown.
